tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (SMELT), as its rigorous compute-matched methodology for comparing looped MoE architectures establishes a principled evaluation framework that is broadly relevant—and notably, both Paper 2 (Qwen-Drive) and Paper 3 (H3-World) grapple with similar themes of attaching lightweight modules or adaptations to pretrained models while preserving their original capabilities, making SMELT's mechanistic insights about residual updates and attention redistribution a useful lens for interpreting those works.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读论文1（SMELT），因为它对循环MoE架构采用的严格计算匹配方法论建立了一个原理清晰的评估框架，具有广泛参考价值。值得注意的是，论文2（Qwen-Drive）和论文3（H3-World）都涉及在预训练模型上附加轻量模块或适配方法以保留原有能力的主题，因此SMELT关于残差更新和注意力重新分配的机制性发现，可为理解这两篇论文提供有益的分析视角。
